gates.requirement: Bare launch starts/reuses exactly one authenticated daemon and enters the native path from a fresh HOME.
Persisted/in-app provider configuration drives the actual outbound request and first streamed response.
Provider tool call uses the real permission broker, executes the tool, persists typed metadata and continues the provider turn; denial is side-effect free.
Second turn, restart/resume and second-client attachment preserve identical typed history without duplicate execution.
Real native OpenTUI accepts raw input, streams redraws and restores the terminal after resize/suspend/interrupt/failure.
Protected paths, alias/symlink/hardlink escape, foreign/stale daemon identity and secret-output checks pass on the integrated product.
A release-built local artifact passes the complete Phase-1 journey on one exact SHA from a fresh disposable HOME.
